changes: Implemented runtime PINN claim-admissibility commands, schema and evidence receipt checks, A1-A4/B1-B15 benchmark, sanitized report renderer, CLI policy and config registration, explicit productionReadyClaim refusal, and smoke coverage for F-001..F-018 including malformed evidence, supplied-report overclaims, and CLI production-readiness flag rejection.
usage: Run node bin/lattice.js pinn_claim_check --fixture=complete --claimId=C9 --format=json, node bin/lattice.js pinn_benchmark_run --format=json, node bin/lattice.js pinn_report_render --format=text, or npm run test:pinn-claim-admissibility from the story worktree.
expectedOutcome: Complete C9 evidence advances only as local claim admissibility; A4 rejects all B1-B15 injections; reports show artifact index and fixed boundary while all completion, PDE, deployment, and production readiness claims remain false; CLI rejects explicit production, deployment, completion, and PDE overclaim flags.
actualTranscript: Observed pinn_claim_check allowed=true and nextAction=advance with 9 adapters and all claim flags false including productionReadyClaim=false; benchmark suiteStatus=PASS with A3 acceptedCount=14 and unsupportedAcceptanceCount=14 while A4 rejectedInjectionCount=15/15; report renders artifactIndex and fixed boundary; malformed receipts return allowed=false,nextAction=stop,malformed_*; passive PDE and production-readiness report overclaims are rejected; all three pinn_* commands reject productionReadyClaim and productionDone style flags at CLI validation.
outcomeDiff: No user-value difference: actual output matches the expected local claim-admissibility boundary. A3 count is documented as current 14 rather than stale 12.
limitations: No scientific PDE correctness proof, no evidence-producing scientific verifier scripts, no lifecycle mutation, no production readiness claim, and no external Authority completion claim.
pitfalls: Main advanced repeatedly from other local stories during TEST, so final evidence had to be refreshed after several merges; keep final delivery, summary, and quorum after the last story-owned material change, and avoid treating old planning prose as stronger than fresh Lattice evidence.
